ValidationRule.description: If Tanium Platform Version is not "7.4.6+", then make Hostnames a required field If Tanium Infrastructure Required is not "Yes – Tanium as a Service" then make Hostname a required field
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT(ISPICKVAL(Tanium_Infrastructure__c, 'Yes – Tanium as a Service')), NOT(ISPICKVAL(License_Version_6_5_or_7_x__c, '7.4.6+')), ISBLANK(Server_Names__c))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: If Tanium Platform Version is not "7.4.6+" (OR) If Tanium Infrastructure Required is not "Yes - Tanium as a Service", Please enter a value in the Hostnames field
